feature: Single-equipment analysis with location and area
notes: PlannerMC RF-1 specifies one equipment per analysis and preconfigured location/area; prototype uses a synthetic local catalog.

feature: Manual/OEM documents, external research, or planner data used to draft a PM
notes: Planner-provided information is now a reviewed source record that can be referenced by a PM; manual upload, external research, and technical generation are not implemented.

feature: Source provenance, evidence references, and visible limitations
notes: Planner-provided source details, review status, PM-level references, and limitations are persisted; field-level citations and external source references are not implemented.

feature: Direct sub-assets under an equipment hierarchy
notes: Equipment root and direct children can be edited and confirmed individually; deeper hierarchy is not available.

feature: Generate an English PM procedure with safety, operating state, actions, and final check
notes: The planner authors the procedure; the prototype provides operating-state, safety, action, and verification fields but does not generate or validate technical content or language.

feature: Limit each PM to 15 steps and ask before splitting
notes: The editor counts the opening statement and final verification toward 15; PM splitting is not implemented.

feature: Review, edit, approve, and retain dated PM versions
notes: Draft editing, local save/read-back, and initial approval are implemented; formal revision history is not.

feature: Bilingual Spanish/English conversation by text and voice
notes: Text/voice conversation and language preference are not implemented in this slice.

feature: Copy PM manually to the selected CMMS
notes: Full PM and individual step copy actions are local clipboard actions; no CMMS is contacted.
